hostedService.conclusion: With the issued app_id the hosted service works end to end for streaming and file recognition. It stays the default; the office gateway remains as a commented fallback because it is much faster but intranet-only.
hostedService.appId: Issued by the speech group on 2026-09-17 and verified end to end.

latency.note: The hosted gateway is far slower than the office node on the whole-file pass, which is what forced the file budget to follow segment length.

hostedService.outputLimit: A 51-second stretch of continuous speech with no pause returned {type: error, code: output_limit} at 36 s of audio. The segment's saved WAV was re-recognised through /infer and produced the full punctuated text, so the recording and the transcript both survived. The office gateway's comparable bound was audio_limit at 60 s.
hostedService.languageIdentification: The English automatic-detection regression is present on the hosted service too: english_1 and english_2 both come back as Chinese on auto and correct when named. It is the same model behind both gateways.
